name: passenger arrival intensity
definition: Rate of individual passenger arrivals to the terminal
source_or_basis: Scenario protocol: demand must be consistent with the flight manifest and arrival profile. D4.1 v2: PAR-051/052/053/054/062; see D4_1_cenarios.md.

name: aircraft arrival intensity
definition: Rate of aircraft arriving for service
source_or_basis: LIT-006 scenario range. D4.1 v2: PAR-051 (offered requests); see D4_1_cenarios.md.

name: passenger arrival lead time
definition: Time from passenger terminal arrival to scheduled departure
source_or_basis: PAR-004/LIT-002 Feldhoff 2022 Table 2 pp. 6-7; literature scenario relative to scheduled departure. D4.1 v2: PAR-054 uniform shape SUPPOSED (beta parameters not reported); see D4_1_cenarios.md.

name: check-in service time
definition: Service time at check-in counter or kiosk
source_or_basis: PAR-030/032; Felix 2015 pp. 54-55, airport transfer candidates only; staffed and self-service service times require separate adoption. Phase D verification: PAR-046 staffed counter 180 s. See phase_d_terminal_verification.json.

name: security screening service time
definition: Service time at full passenger security screening (author decision 2026-11-18)
source_or_basis: PAR-033/LIT-030 Janssen et al. 2020 Sections 2-3 Tables 2 and 4; airport lane contains overlapping subprocesses and internal waits, so checkpoint transit time is not adopted as service time. Phase D verification: PAR-047 full screening 90 s. See phase_d_terminal_verification.json.

name: baggage check service time
definition: Service time at carry-on baggage check station (author decision 2026-11-18)
source_or_basis: PAR-028/LIT-010, section Vertiport simulation: U(30,60) s is the source authors’ assumption adopted in D2; order unresolved (VAR-034)

name: pad occupancy time
definition: Physical exclusive occupation from touchdown to aircraft exit from the TLOF in Phase A
source_or_basis: PAR-043 adopted towed scenario at 37.7 s; LIT-008 Sec. 5.1.1.5 and LIT-003 Tab. A1 establish events; empirical duration remains undefined

name: stand turnaround time
definition: Elapsed stand occupation from acquisition to release, including applicable service and blocking while held
source_or_basis: D2 turn chain and event log; LIT-008 Secs. 5.1.1.1 and 5.1.1.5; use decomposed services in integrated model

name: charging duration
definition: Service duration assigned to each turnaround: 0 (no charging), 30 (baseline), or 60 min; location is VAR-021
source_or_basis: PAR-002/LIT-001 Preis 2023 Secs. 3.1 and 3.3; reservation LIT-008 Sec. 5.1.1.6.4; author decision 2026-11-18; reference vehicle VoloCity, with concurrent service and boarding in source

name: number of pads
definition: Available TLOF or operational pads
source_or_basis: EASA PTS-VPT-DSN modular baseline one FATO-TLOF

name: number of stands or gates
definition: Available aircraft positions serving passenger interface
source_or_basis: EASA PTS-VPT-DSN modular baseline one stand

name: number of chargers
definition: Available simultaneous charging positions
source_or_basis: D2: zero in Phase A/no local charging; one position proposed for stand charging in unitary Phase C; dedicated capacity by scenario

name: passengers per flight
definition: Passenger group matched to one piloted reference eVTOL
source_or_basis: Aircraft reference registry; four passenger seats plus pilot; use VAR-032 for composition and frequency of groups

name: aircraft reference geometry
definition: Certified enclosing-circle dimension used in applicable geometric design rules
source_or_basis: Requires aircraft AFM or certified design data

name: charging location
definition: Charging at stand, at a separate position, or absent; use with VAR-008
source_or_basis: LIT-008 Sec. 5.1.1.6.4 p. 73, LIT-013 C.200(f), LIT-022 p. 1; D2 proposes stand as starting configuration and tracks repositioning under VAR-038

name: departure readiness
definition: Aircraft and stand available; deboarding complete; positive declared charge completed before boarding; crew ready; accepted group completed mandatory processing and boarding; dispatch authorised; slot valid where applicable

name: passenger gate movement times
definition: Walk holding area to gate door; door to aircraft proximity; leaving gate after deboarding
source_or_basis: Preis and Hornung 2022 Table 3 expert values (PAR-022 to PAR-024)

name: passenger terminal time to boarding
definition: Elapsed time from individual terminal arrival to start of that passenger boarding
source_or_basis: Simulation timestamps; boarding starts on entering aircraft per Preis and Hornung 2022 Table A1 B3; boarding completion belongs to VAR-022

name: eVTOL delay
definition: Elapsed wait for requested movement or departure; use request-to-touchdown delay in Phase A
source_or_basis: Simulation timestamps; D2 Phase A and scenario protocol

name: passenger LoS maximum waiting time
definition: Maximum acceptable waiting time per processing station under the IATA ADRM LoS time criterion
source_or_basis: PAR-026/LIT-002 Table 5: counter 180 s; self-service 120 s; security 180 s; no baggage threshold (VAR-030)

name: LoS compliance
definition: Per station proportion of complete observed waits (VAR-029) at or below VAR-014; undefined without threshold or complete visits
source_or_basis: Feldhoff 2022 Table 5 and p. 10 NALoS complement on same population; censored waits reported separately; D2 metric specification

name: throughput
definition: Passenger eVTOL liftoffs observed within a fixed horizon divided by that horizon in hours; report offered and admitted requests separately
source_or_basis: Simulation liftoff event timestamps and D2 scenario protocol; physical resource counts are VAR-009/010/011/042

name: resource utilization
definition: Time physically occupied divided by observation time per resource; availability restrictions measured separately
source_or_basis: D2 Phase A and scenario protocol; resource logs

name: slot release rule
definition: Advance admission conditional on compatible window and future resources versus local FCFS allocation by request time under the same offered demand and service levels; a technical timeline reservation can occur in FCFS
source_or_basis: LIT-008 Sec. 5.1 and LIT-004/D026 pp. 3-4 and 9-10; D2 and scenario protocol; VAR-039 holds parameters still pending

name: station queue wait
definition: Entry to station queue until start of service; 0 if immediate; flag unfinished waits
source_or_basis: D2 metric specification; Feldhoff 2022 Tab. 5 and p. 10; Felix 2015 p. 56 for queue-event definition (LIT-031)

name: baggage check LoS limit
definition: Waiting limit for mandatory carry-on baggage check
source_or_basis: LIT-002 Tab. 5 provides no limit for this station; D2

name: post-exit TLOF separation
definition: Time from physical exit to next permissible occupation; distinct from physical occupancy
source_or_basis: PAR-029/LIT-003 Table 3 and Table A1 A4; case trace values in scenario protocol are synthetic

name: flight manifest and arrival coupling
definition: Assignment to flight ID and destination with counts by flight and individual arrival times
source_or_basis: LIT-029 by-the-seat precedent; LIT-010 shared destination; scenario protocol; counts and arrival dependence pending. D4.1 v2: PAR-052/053/054/059; see D4_1_cenarios.md.

name: group closure and incomplete manifests
definition: Cutoff and disposition of absent, late or unprocessed passengers and of flights with nobody ready
source_or_basis: LIT-028 Sec. 5 is a mechanism precedent only; cutoff, no-show rate and disposition undefined. Phase D verification: Verify presence at manifest close; dispatch with at least one present; wait for admitted passengers to finish processing. See phase_d_terminal_verification.json. D4.1 v2: PAR-053/059/062; see D4_1_cenarios.md.

name: baggage and security station order
definition: Precedence of dedicated carry-on baggage check and full security screening
source_or_basis: LIT-010 and LIT-008 do not establish precedence of these distinct adopted stations. Phase D verification: Counter then baggage then full screening. See phase_d_terminal_verification.json. D4.1 v2: counter, baggage, full security; see D4_1_cenarios.md.

name: operating and observation horizon
definition: Admission window, initial conditions and termination or follow-up rule
source_or_basis: LIT-032 Secs. 3 and 5; terminating design proposed, numeric horizon pending. Phase D verification: 6000 s terminating empty-start trace. See phase_d_terminal_verification.json. D4.1 v2: PAR-050; offers from 2700 s; see D4_1_cenarios.md.

name: replications
definition: Independent replications with policies paired within each replication; 30 final replications chosen after the precision pilot
source_or_basis: LIT-032 Secs. 2, 4 and 6; scenario protocol; D4.3 pilot plan and result

name: replication random seeds
definition: Versioned random inputs and seeds by replication and randomness source; pilot 10001--10030 and final experiment 20001--20030
source_or_basis: LIT-032 Secs. 2 and 4; scenario protocol; D4.3 pilot plan and result

name: repositioning for dedicated charging
definition: Movements and stand release/reacquisition for charging away from passenger stand
source_or_basis: LIT-008 Sec. 5.1.1.6.4; route, duration and resource rules pending

name: coordination settings
definition: Reservation windows, tolerances, reallocation and operational ties
source_or_basis: LIT-008 Secs. 5.1.1.2 and 5.1.1.4; D2 local comparison; settings pending. Phase D verification: Inclusive touchdown windows; FCFS request order; stable input order on ties. See phase_d_terminal_verification.json. D4.1 v2: PAR-055/056/058/062; see D4_1_cenarios.md.

name: departure punctuality tolerance
definition: Tolerance relative to requested departure time for the punctuality indicator
source_or_basis: D2 metric specification; tolerance must be declared before reporting. Phase D verification: PAR-049 late tolerance 60 s. See phase_d_terminal_verification.json.

name: taxi route service and capacity
definition: Route travel time, reservation and physical occupation between TLOF exit and stand (reverse for departure)
source_or_basis: PAR-044 adopted towed scenario at 22.8 s per leg; LIT-034 Secs. 3.1-3.2 and Fig. 4 for distance/speed and events; reserve route and destination before transfer, release route at physical clearance

name: terminal station configuration
definition: Servers, queue capacities and check-in channels for mandatory terminal processing
source_or_basis: LIT-002 pp. 4-5 and 9; PAR-005 to PAR-007 progressive routing candidate only; scenario configuration pending. Phase D verification: One staffed counter, one baggage server and one full screening server; queue space for the trace. See phase_d_terminal_verification.json. D4.1 v2: one server at each station in base; two counters (PAR-060) or two screening posts (PAR-061) in contrasts; see D4_1_cenarios.md.

name: sensitivity LoS limits
definition: Optional threshold set applied to same complete waits as primary criterion
source_or_basis: PAR-031/LIT-002 Table 6; optional proposal

name: gate passenger service composition
definition: Occupancy and concurrency of individual boarding and deboarding processes
source_or_basis: LIT-003 Tables 3 and A1 define event times (PAR-008/009/022/023/024); group handling and resource occupancy rule pending. Phase D verification: Serial individual access and boarding; all inbound passengers clear before charging. See phase_d_terminal_verification.json. D4.1 v2: one gate per stand (SUPPOSED, PAR-057), serial individual access per flight; see D4_1_cenarios.md.
